author: Steve Ash
text: We were very pleased with the two gentlemen that helped us with a new hot water tank. They made a recommendation initially for a very functional but more reasonable system than another company proposed. They also checked out our plumbing under the house, and told us some shortcomings but did not recommend any work at this point.. Another company proposed that everything under the house, be replumbed. And that would’ve been very very expensive. We appreciated the friendliness, their professionalism and their integrity. We would not hesitate to use them again, and would highly recommend them!

author: Peter Klinzman
text: We hired White Knight Plumbing do a repipe on our home.  We got bids from 3 other companies, and found White Knight’s to be the most competitive. We were very pleased with the quality and timeliness of the work.  Hans and Kyle were courteous and conscientious.  We would hire White Knight again.

author: Colleen Graney
text: Contacted White Knight right after the fourth of July holiday and they were able to come out right away. Did a great job and found the problem in no time. Advised us on how to prevent the same problem in the future. I would recommend them and will use them again in the future with no reservations. Thanks!

author: Diana Cornacchia
text: Hans was on time and super thorough. I’ve used White Knight since moving to the PNW and have never called another plumbing service.  I highly recommend.

author: David Matarazzo
text: Fantastic company! When other plumbers wanted thousands of dollars for a simple fix, Chris found the part I needed and got it for me under warranty. Saved me so much money and trouble! This is my plumber!
